name: Tarifflo Inc.
long_description:
Tarifflo is the modern ABI, built for the AI agent era.

Legacy ABI software was built for people keying entries into screens. Tarifflo is built for code and agents. Every part of customs work is an API call: create entries from documents, classify every line to HTS, fill PGA records, apply Chapter 99 duties, transmit to CBP and track status through liquidation.

Your agents can file customs. Connect Claude or any MCP client and it prepares full entries using the same API. You review and approve, and Tarifflo files under your own filer code. Developers get REST and webhooks. Everyone gets one key, one meter and one bill.

Under it all is the same engine: live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion and rate change. The duty you file going forward is as right as the duty we audit looking back. 1 in 8 products we audit is overpaying, and if you overpaid on past entries we find it and file for your refund.
one_liner: Supply chain compliance and cost savings
